'''The Claw''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. He hunted a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yaronn]] who he believed were responsible for the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his [[The Claw's brother|brother]].
